description: This opportunity entails developing the value chain for the production of mechanical seals for industrial equipment to serve KSA and the broader GCC region.Overall demand for mechanical seals in Saudi Arabia has been growing, estimated to be 19,000 units in 2017. Demand in KSA is estimated at SAR ~240 Mn, accounting for ~40% GCC 
demand and expected to grow 3x by 2030

limited utilization in KSA market

monitoring stations drives demand through upgrades
•

facilities and utilities

of ~ 7%, driven by public and private sector initiatives to reduce air 
pollution 
•
Market is characterized by a mix of established multinational 
companies and specialized regional firms
•
Demand is rising for portable air quality monitors and comprehensive 
solutions that measure multiple pollutants simultaneously
•
Increasing integration of IoT sensors (e.g., CEMS) and ambient air 
quality systems into smart city infrastructure

of the total waste produced worldwide and is

waste generation

government incentives for homeownership
